author: Top Gear
description:
Over the past 18 months The Stig has been let loose at Dunsfold to set some lap times. We’ve had the latest and greatest performance cars along to the Top Gear test track, plus everything from 2000hp rocket ships to restomod 911s that rev to the moon. We might even have set a new lap record…
